query:
SELECT 
  SUM(creditBalanceUsd) as total_credit_balance_usd,
  SUM(currentBalanceUsd) as total_current_balance_usd,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN currentBalanceUsd > 0 THEN 1 END) as customers_with_debt,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN creditBalanceUsd > 0 THEN 1 END) as customers_with_credit
FROM customerAccounts
